name: Phys3DGS BRDF Function
definition: A physically-based BRDF function consisting of a diffuse and a specular component, using roughness remapping and a correlated Smith masking-shadowing function.
summary: Phys3DGS BRDF is a physically-based function for 3D Gaussian Splatting inverse rendering that uses GGX microfacets with correlated Smith masking-shadowing and roughness remapping for higher accuracy than the Modified Disney model.
